name: Home title emblem
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final transparent typographic graphic artwork, an ornate premium sci-fi memory-game title logo for children aged 8 and up.
Primary request: Create ONE lavish dimensional GAME TITLE LOGO with exactly the following Traditional Chinese text, written perfectly, centered on TWO lines:
Line 1: 失聯
Line 2: 太空站
These are exactly FIVE Chinese characters in total. Preserve Traditional Chinese 聯 exactly. The text must read 失聯 / 太空站, with no slash rendered. No additional text of any kind.
Scene/backdrop: Genuinely transparent background with alpha. No flat background, no rectangular badge, no plaque, no scene, no baked checkerboard.
Composition/framing: Landscape 4:3 canvas, target 1536 x 1152 pixels. The complete logo silhouette is entirely visible, tightly framed, approximately 85% of the canvas width, with at least 7% clear edge padding. The two lines form one cohesive emblem. Keep every flourish, shadow, ray and sparkle inside the canvas with clear margin.
Style/medium: Beautiful custom sculpted Traditional Chinese typography, premium polished 3D game emblem. Chunky and highly legible letterforms with polished thick extruded platinum and titanium faces, sapphire-cyan luminous inset edges, restrained gold bevel accents, deep dimensional shadows and rich layered physical depth. A subtle orbital arc sits behind the lettering, supporting rather than obscuring it. Controlled light rays and a few elegant sparkles add luxury without visual clutter. Navy, cyan and amber identity. Much more lavish than ordinary web text. Friendly adventurous sci-fi, never horror.
Text (verbatim):
失聯
太空站
Constraints: Exactly the five specified Chinese characters in two lines. No other characters, English, tagline, numbers, captions, logos or watermark. Do not create a UI screen. No thin font. Do not obscure, replace, distort or omit Chinese strokes for ornament. Preserve legibility and genuine transparent alpha. ONE final image.

name: Home navigation and instruction sprite atlas
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final transparent production game-UI sprite atlas for homepage controls and a pictorial instruction in a navy and cyan sci-fi survival memory game for children aged 8 and up.
Primary request: Create ONE image with exactly SIX isolated dimensional game-item motifs in THREE columns and TWO rows.
Scene/backdrop: Genuinely transparent background with alpha. No scene, no solid or gradient background, no baked-in checkerboard, no grid lines, no dividers.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2 canvas, target 1536 x 1024 pixels, exactly six equally sized SQUARE cells of 512 x 512 pixels. Center every complete icon precisely within its own cell with at least 12% empty padding on all four sides. Use equal apparent scale. No object or glow may cross into another cell.
Strict reading order:
TOP LEFT: a small but complete orbital SPACE STATION with a circular structural ring and a few warmly lit windows, unmistakably a restored working station.
TOP MIDDLE: a beautiful circular CYAN REACTOR-RING EMBLEM for a small navigation brand, a simple thick dimensional silver and navy ring around a glowing cyan core.
TOP RIGHT: a SILVER AND CYAN LOUDSPEAKER with exactly TWO clear sound-wave arcs, unmistakably sound-on.
BOTTOM LEFT: a large dimensional GOLDEN QUESTION MARK mounted on a small navy circular disc. The glyph must be exactly ? and is the ONLY allowable textual glyph in this atlas.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: an OPEN SCI-FI HATCH OR DOOR with a clear bold dimensional ARROW pointing OUTWARD TO THE RIGHT, instantly recognizable as exit.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a compact glowing GOLDEN LIGHTNING ENERGY BOLT, unmistakable power symbol.
Style/medium: Consistent polished premium 3D game-item illustration. Soft substantial bevels, brushed silver and navy metal, luminous cool cyan, warm gold and amber accents. Frontal or shallow isometric views, clear strong silhouettes. Fewer tiny details, readable at 40 pixels. Dimensional objects with soft studio highlights and object-only shadows. Child-friendly and approachable.
Constraints: Exactly SIX motifs, one per specified cell. No captions, numbers, letter labels, other textual glyphs, scene, grid lines, border, extra icons, logo text, watermark, UI screenshot or controls surrounding the icons. Only the question mark ? in the bottom-left cell is permitted as text. Preserve genuine transparency and sufficient empty padding. ONE final image.
